key: Another batch is ready to smuggle back to the Underdark. Take extra care with these ones, as it contains samples from some of the Absolute's Disciples. Their blood will be the most evolved and potent yet. Check the usual spot by the well near the old mill.

Balthazar needs another live pixie for his experiments, but these buggers are nearly impossible to catch. I believe we've finally tracked them down to their home though; a cave accessed through the trunk of a great tree. Their lair doesn't seem to be particularly well-guarded, so it should be a quick job. We're prepping our traps now, and plan to ambush them while they sleep. Absolute-willing, the plan will go smoothly and we'll be back in Moonrise before long.

Absolute-willing, the plan will go smoothly and we’ll be back in Moonrise before long.

I have witnessed the light cleansing the Shadows of Moonrise, just as the Sunmaster at Waterdeep foresaw. I know now that my purpose is ordained and righteous. My companions have not died in vain to this wretched cult. Once I deliver the Sun Crystal to the top of the spire and activate it, these lands will bask in the light of the Morninglory once more.

It feels like our small town is smaller by the day.

With the stone exports to Reithwin and Moonrise Towers stopping, the quarry has closed up again, and many can tell this town may be on borrowed time. Traders seem to exclusively take the Skuldask road these days, or sail straight to Baldur’s Gate with their goods, leaving us with nothing to barter with.

Now there are rumors of war brewing again, and anxiety seems to drive every conversation. Many are choosing to start new lives in Baldur’s Gate or elsewhere. My family has been here for generations, but I’m not sure that is a good enough reason to stay anymore.

Just as my ancestors fought for glory at the Battle for Sunrise Spire and beyond, I too have become a conqueror of these lands that will be remembered for generations. As one of his oldest followers, Lord Ketheric entrusted me to show the strength of the Absolute, spreading Her word through the Fields of the Dead by war and bloodshed! From the ashes the Army of the Absolute will rise.

My wish has been granted, and the family vault overflows with the spoils of war. Grandfather’s “old gnomish trick” has been the only way to hide such a vast hoard below the manor without the servants taking notice. Yet I yearn for only one thing now: Power. Nothing can compare to the gifts She has granted me in battle and the ability to crush my enemies. The wealth I once craved seems a distant thing in comparison to what I feel now.

Lathander Guides the Way Forward to Those Who Demonstrate His Virtues:

Protect the Innocent Against Evil

Be a Beacon of Hope to Others

Bring Daylight to the Shadows

Bless All With Lathander's Renewal

My loyalty to Voss proves correct once more. The Prism is linked not only to Vlaakith, but an Elder Brain.

We’ve set up camp and are monitoring the cultists. Without their general, it seems they are disorganized, but are still planning to march on Baldur's Gate. There isn’t much time left to act.

The Astral Prism is still key to our mission. If it falls into the hands of the cult or Vlaakith before it reaches us in Rivington, we have only this one chance to strike and reclaim the Prism before it is lost forever.

I believe Ch'r'ai Kalithrazz and his Knights are on our trail once again. Those who hold the prism have proven powerful warriors, but they stand no chance against one who has killed so many of our most capable fighters and matched even the great Voss himself. Voss claimed victory in our last altercation with Kalithrazz, but not without injury. It is unlikely we’ll survive another encounter against him or his dragon.

Our peaceful monastery finds itself in the middle of a civil war between greedy lords staking claim to the nearby ferry. With Sunrise Spire overlooking it, these warmongers have turned their sights on us. Already their armies gather outside and mean to occupy this sacred place to wage their war.

The First Prior has entrusted me with our most sacred weapon: The Dawnblade. I must use it to shatter the crystal atop the spire and prevent it from falling into enemy hands. Our most powerful wards will be placed to protect the inner workings of the spire. In the wrong hands, it would be a devastating force, and so it must be destroyed.

The cultist army is on the move. Watch the pass coming from the Shadow-Cursed Lands. The artefact thieves will take this path if Ch’r’ai Tska’an fails. Eliminate any cultist stragglers you find.

My squad will travel to Sunrise Spire in pursuit of the traitor Voss.

- Ch’r’ai Kalithrazz
This is the gem found in that hidden chamber in the Anga Vled Mines. It could be special. Take care not to mix it up with the other gems until it can be studied further!

We have orders to collapse the pass near the old quarry at Anga Vled to slow down any Harpers heading our way. When you’re done, round up the others at the checkpoint and get back to the ferry. The rest of the army is already across the river, preparing for the march to the siege camp. We don’t have further orders from the General or the Disciples yet, but we need to be ready to move out when we do.

- True Soul Jojie

While my superiors sleep in cozy beds in Moonrise, I’m stuck in camp sleeping next to an ogre for yet another night. At least the ale is kept close by. More pilgrims arrive from the Fields of the Dead each day, but myself and my comrades are beginning to grow restless.

[Last Entry]

Praise the Absolute!

Today The Absolute has risen above Moonrise and announced our conquest of Baldur's Gate. Seeing her in glorious form has filled me with a renewed vigor. We march to victory!
